c74object.name: evi_butterworth8
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Variable order TPT Butterworth Lowpass filter
c74object.description:
evi_butterworth8 is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_butterworth8.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_approx.genexpr
evi_butterworth8 is also available in MSP as: evi.butterworthlp8~.
This is a clean, linear, surgical filter but can still be updated alias-free at audio rate if required. Very useful for clean top and tail of audio chains.

geninlet.name: audio
geninlet.digest: Input. Audio input to be filtered.

geninlet.name: cutoff
geninlet.digest: in Hz @default samplerate*0.5-1800. Cutoff frequency of the lowpass filter.

attribute.name: order
attribute.description: 0 = bypass, 1..8 = filter order. 1 is a 1-pole filter, 8 is a steep 8-pole filter.

attribute.name: smooth
attribute.description: Smoothing time for the cutoff frequency (inlet 2). Turn off (0) if modulating inlet 2 at audio rate.
